correctness.rationale: In normalized coordinates u=ps/2, v=t, d=-(u+v), the given pq=4 map on E={u>0,0<d<u} is the exact affine shear (u,v)->(u-2d,v+2d), preserving d until first exit. All k=0..n remain in E iff (2n+1)d<u. Exact beta>-1 integral over 0<u<R,0<d<u/(2n+1) yields survival (2n+1)^-(beta+1); successive differences give first-exit masses; the p-series criterion for E[J^alpha] has strict transition alpha=beta+1; conditional z=(2n+1)d/u creates factorized u^(beta+1)z^beta density. Uniform-beta truncated means are the odd harmonic sum. Strict boundary, unbounded residence region and Jacobians agree with frozen claim. Independent Fraction tests of 1194 first exits corroborated the general exact branch derivation.
residual_risks: The claim is restricted to the strict first-exit domain and given transverse density; no global dynamics after exit or arbitrary-density asymptotic is established. Finite rational tests alone would not prove real-parameter laws.
